welcome.title: Home
points: Start with "Recommendation from menu" when you want GustaroAI to choose from a menu.
Use "Adjust my profile" to tell GustaroAI what you like, avoid, or cannot tolerate.
Your profile stays saved so the next recommendation can feel more personal.
If a recommendation already exists, GustaroAI takes you straight back to it.
welcome.tip: You do not need to prepare everything. A menu and a short taste cue are often enough.

pickInput.title: Show menu
points: You can show GustaroAI a menu in several ways: paste a link, scan a QR code, take a photo, or paste menu text. Before GustaroAI recommends dishes for you, you can quickly review your preferences. Afterwards, you return directly to the menu analysis - your link, QR code, photo, or text stays in place.
With 'What should I recommend?' you choose between starters and salads or main courses.
Once you have chosen a dish, you can optionally ask for a starter or salad as an additional course.
This limits the dish space for the analysis - your profile still remains important.
The analysis can take a little time, especially with longer menus.
pickInput.tip: The clearer the menu is, the better GustaroAI can choose.

result.title: Your recommendation
points: Recommendation 1 is GustaroAI's best choice from the recognized menu.
Menus are not always fully readable. Some dishes may not be detected.
'Show new menu' discards the current recommendation and starts the path to a new analysis.
If you are unsure, you can open the original menu and check it yourself.
result.tip: The original menu helps you verify prices, ingredients, and availability directly with the restaurant.

profile.title: Your taste
points: Under "General", you set the language GustaroAI uses for answers.
Preferences help GustaroAI favor dishes that fit you better.
Exclusions avoid ingredients or dishes you do not want recommended.
Allergies are handled especially strictly.
profile.tip: Everything is optional. Even a few details can make the recommendation feel more personal.

profileGeneral.title: General
points: The UI language is the language of the app interface, including menus and buttons.
The output language defines the language GustaroAI uses for recommendations and explanations.
They can be different: you can use the app in one language and receive recommendations in another.
profileGeneral.tip: The output language mainly affects recommendation texts and translations.

profilePreferences.title: My preferences
points: Tap to select a preference. Tap again to deselect it.
Selected preferences help GustaroAI prefer dishes that better match your taste.
You can add your own terms in the input field. A single word is enough, for example 'coriander' or 'sushi'.
You can remove active preferences in the 'Remove active preferences' section.
When you come from menu analysis, "Back to selection" takes you directly there again. Your link, QR code, photo, or text stays in place.
profilePreferences.tip: Preferences increase the chance that GustaroAI matches your taste.

profileExclusions.title: My exclusions
points: Tap to select an exclusion. Tap again to deselect it.
Selected exclusions tell GustaroAI what should not be recommended.
You can add your own terms in the input field. A single word is enough, for example 'lamb' or 'mushrooms'.
You can remove active exclusions in the 'Remove active exclusions' section.
profileExclusions.tip: Exclusions are useful when you want to avoid certain ingredients or dishes.

profileIntolerances.title: Allergies
points: Allergens are a fixed GustaroAI list.
Activate the allergens that are relevant for you.
Specific personal exclusions or intolerances that are not included in this list should be entered under “Exclusions & intolerances.”
If a recognized allergen is missing, please report it via the feedback form.
profileIntolerances.tip: Basis: EU – 14 mandatory allergens under food information rules; U.S. – FDA “major food allergens,” including sesame; international – Codex-/FAO-WHO-oriented allergen standards and guidance.

profileIntolerancesOnly.title: Intolerances
points: You can add your own terms in the input field. A single word is enough, for example 'lactose' or 'histamine'.
These entries are considered especially strictly.
You can remove active entries in the active intolerances section.
profileIntolerancesOnly.tip: GustaroAI considers your intolerances strictly where they can be identified from the menu.
